content.short: TosiDrop is a premier token distribution platform on Cardano and Ergo for vending machines and airdrops.
content.description: TosiDrop is an all-encompassing token distribution platform specifically designed for the Cardano and Ergo blockchains. The protocol enables developers to distribute tokens to their communities through two primary mechanisms: an automated vending machine for manual claims and a bulk airdrop tool for mass distribution via CSV uploads. Powered by the $cTOSI and $eTOSI tokens, the platform prioritizes decentralization and user safety. By simplifying the distribution process, TosiDrop helps new projects bootstrap their ecosystems and engage with participants across both networks.
